correctness.rationale: The lower certificate is a valid trial-measure energy bound; an independent numerical recomputation gives capacity \(0.2215367734\ldots\), safely above 0.221. The upper certificate's cell potential formula is correct, and splitting at the singular endpoints and unique critical point suffices to bound each contribution. A separate dense recomputation gives an upper value near 0.22911, consistent with the exact certified 0.2292253 bound. The scripts use rational arithmetic and certified logarithm enclosures in place of those floating checks, so the claimed \(0.221\le\operatorname{cap}(E_3)\le0.230\) is supported.
